scope: One bounded material transition: historical CompanyImport lease initialization in migration 0554 and its current bounded recovery owner. This is not the complete V10 change register; unrelated and unreviewed working-tree changes are out of scope.
qualificationBoundary: File hashes identify the inspected working-tree bytes. They are not commit IDs, immutable release artifacts, external approval, or proof of performance/hosted behavior.

nodes.reasonNow: Historical 0554 remains byte-identical. The migration runner now applies a 0554-specific lock budget, row-count admission cap, statement timeout, rollback, and retry guidance in the existing transaction. Four embedded-Postgres tests pass on pinned source; production population and lock profile remain unmeasured.
protectedInvariants: Preserve 0554 historical SQL bytes and prior migration ordering.
Never replay an import effect based only on an expired lease; retain needs_reconciliation for unknown outcomes.
Do not write the migration journal entry unless every migration statement commits.

migrationPhases.authority: Existing migration runner transaction; no change to historical SQL or operation authority.
migrationPhases.preconditions: The table is present at the expected legacy schema. The migration runner holds its normal per-file transaction.
migrationPhases.allowedVersions: No mixed-version allowlist is established by source; release operator must drain CompanyImport writers and keep application traffic drained through the migration.
migrationPhases.action: Inside the existing transaction, set lock_timeout=5000ms and preflight statement_timeout=5000ms, acquire ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on customer_operations (the first ALTER already requires this lock), count running CompanyImport rows, and refuse more than 10,000. If admitted, apply statement_timeout=120000ms before the unchanged 0554 statements.
migrationPhases.stopCondition: Lock/preflight statement timeout, migration statement timeout, or a preflight count above 10,000.
migrationPhases.expectedState: On success, unchanged 0554 statements and journal entry commit together. On any failure, the whole migration transaction rolls back and no journal row is written.
migrationPhases.verification: A representative 10,000-row fixture completes and commits; a 10,001-row fixture refuses before DDL; a blocked table lock times out and rolls back without a journal row.
migrationPhases.recovery: Keep application traffic drained, inspect blockers and the running CompanyImport population, resolve the blocker, and retry the identical migration; if the measured population cannot fit the budget, prepare a separately reviewed bounded procedure before retry.
